structured.reason: The description contains conditional or minimizing statements that fail the strict criterion. (1) "Apply as directed on the label, and you can see measurable improvement in fine lines and uneven tone after six weeks of consistent use" makes results conditional on correct use and a time period, which implies the product only works under certain conditions. (2) "Peptides and green tea support firmer-looking skin over time" is a time-dependent hedge. (3) "gentle exfoliation" softens the harshness that reviewers complain about ("Yes, it does burn for the first couple a minutes"), so it addresses a review complaint in a minimizing way. Under the strict reading, where any doubt should lead to failing, these count as negative signals.
